meta.title: Records-request routing for this draft
meta.note: Routing is to official agency FOIA or public-records pages. Private contractors are not themselves subject to FOIA; records about those sites are requested from the agency that holds them. Addresses and portals can change; check the official page before sending.

army.component: Department of the Army, Freedom of Information Act office
army.portal: Submit through the Army FOIA page or FOIA.gov after confirming the current installation or command office.
army.notes: Name the installation and, if known, the command (for example Joint Munitions Command or the garrison). The Army FOIA page lists component offices.

air_force.component: Department of the Air Force FOIA Requester Service Center
air_force.notes: Covers U.S. Air Force and, for many records, U.S. Space Force installations. Name the base and unit if you know them.

navy.component: Department of the Navy FOIA / Privacy Division (Office of the Secretary of the Navy)
navy.notes: Covers Navy commands and, through Department of the Navy policy, many Marine Corps records. Name the installation and command.

marines.component: U.S. Marine Corps FOIA (Department of the Navy)
marines.notes: Marine Corps FOIA is administered with Department of the Navy FOIA procedures. You may also use the Navy FOIA page if the Marine Corps page is unavailable.

whs.component: Department of Defense, Washington Headquarters Services / OSD FOIA
whs.notes: Use this when the records are held by OSD or a DoD component not listed separately, or when the lead service is unclear. FOIA.gov can also route a request.

doe.notes: NNSA sites (for example Pantex, Los Alamos, Sandia, and the Nevada Field Office) may also be requested through the NNSA FOIA office: https://www.energy.gov/nnsa/nnsa-freedom-information-act-foia

nasa.notes: Name the NASA center (for Wallops, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center / Wallops Flight Facility).

epa.notes: Use EPA FOIA for EPA-held permit, inspection, and enforcement records, including many RCRA files. Name the EPA ID if you have it. State environmental agencies often hold the operating permit file as well.

AL.agency: Alabama official or the Alabama Attorney General
AL.law: Alabama Open Records Act, Ala. Code § 36-12-40 et seq.
AL.notes: Many environmental records are held by the Alabama Department of Environmental Management.
